label: Kingdom Come: Deliverance II sandboxes
description: How Kingdom Come: Deliverance II sandboxes deploy, and how to find the game on this machine. Paths: mo2.

notes: The Mods folder does not exist in a fresh install; it is created on first deploy. Each mod is one folder with a mod.manifest.
Saves are in Saved Games/kingdomcome2/saves, outside the install.
Hard links are the default: nothing is copied twice when two sandboxes share a mod, and every file is still a real file to the game.

presets.label: Clean
presets.description: Nothing deployed - the vanilla game, for checking whether a bug is yours.

options.label: Additional launch arguments
options.description: Passed verbatim. One argument per space; nothing here goes through a shell.
